rows.title: Source map identity
rows.evidence: `src/domain/artifacts.ts`; `src/domain/packet.ts`; `tests/triage-journey.mjs`; `tests/sentry-sdk.mjs`; `tests/agent-handoff.mjs` Agent handoff public journey, second-origin captures: generated frames before upload, originals after upload, immutable admission snapshot beside current lookup, release and build mismatch refusals, confidential-source exclusion. Independent release-only and build-only mismatches preserve every generated frame with an identity_mismatch reason and no original coordinates; a fresh matching capture proves original file, one-based line and zero-based column. `tests/agent-handoff/packet.mjs` generatedFrames and compatible assertions.; `tests/mapped-frames-flow.mjs`; `tests/fidelity-flow.mjs`; mappedScreens covers keyboard paging, stale-read recovery, Axe and reflow with desktop and phone captures.
rows.gap: The five browser source-map acceptance outcomes are asserted through the second-origin Agent handoff public journey. Remaining inherited work: expanded SDK-010 mapped lookup beyond the current 30-coordinate bound and SRC-004's recorded capacity, streaming, artifact lifecycle, isolated opt-in source fetching, ignore-list and production-build qualification. Native-device qualification remains held under SDK-002 and SRC-004; commercial qualification still needs BILL-001's pricing ruling. Existing queue scopes and release prerequisites are unchanged.

rows.title: Unmodified server-runtime SDKs: Python, Go, Java/JVM, Ruby, PHP, .NET, Rust and Elixir
rows.evidence: `tests/sdk-runtimes.mjs`; `tests/runtimes/`; `tests/runtimes/screens.mjs`; `tests/runtimes/python.mjs`; `tests/runtimes/java.mjs`; `src/domain/sentry/auth.ts` Push Verify jobs runtime (python), (go), (java), (ruby), (php), (dotnet), (rust) and (elixir) each run one unmodified SDK program against a reference collector and against Spool with only the DSN changed. Q1: "every SDK error event is a persisted occurrence", "handled exception chain persisted" and the handled issue read through the UI at 1440 and 390. Q2: "unhandled failure persisted as unhandled" (sentry-go v0.50.0 marks a recovered panic only with level fatal, client.go line 805, which Spool keeps); in runtime (elixir) a crashed Task is reported by the SDK's logger handler with handled false, and `tests/runtimes/elixir/app.exs` attaches its cart in the process that runs the checkout, because sentry 14.0.0 loses a crash whose caller holds an attachment (the handler passes the caller's context as capture options, lib/sentry/logger_utils.ex line 30; Sentry.Event.create_event/1 refuses :attachments, lib/sentry/event.ex line 196; the handler swallows the error, lib/sentry/logger_handler.ex line 475). Q3: "the restarted process groups into the same issue" with no duplicate occurrence. Q4: "Spool outcomes reconcile with SDK-sent items" with tracing, logs and an attachment from every runtime and sessions from Python, Java, Ruby (request mode), .NET and Rust; sentry-go v0.50.0, sentry/sentry 4.34.0 (PHP) and sentry 14.0.0 (Elixir) offer no sessions. Q5: "release and dist equal what the SDK sent" and "release is created automatically". Q6: client-report discards in project outcomes (BILL-001 usage) from Python, Go, Java, Ruby, .NET, Rust and Elixir. Ruby at pinned sentry-ruby 7.1.0 requires a real client_report: `tests/runtimes/ruby/app.rb` flushes buffered telemetry, drains the public background worker and closes normally; `tests/runtimes/ruby.mjs` requires the item, and `tests/sdk-runtimes.mjs` asserts "real client reports contain every before_send discard with its exact category and quantity", "usage retains the exact SDK discard reasons, categories and quantities" and "a before_send discard creates no occurrence". The two restarted handled runs report exactly two error-category before_send discards; `tests/runtimes/harness.mjs` reconciles the SDK report quantities with public project outcomes. Pinned PHP SDK 4.34.0 still only logs this before_send drop (Client.php lines 354-366) and sends no client report. Q7: "refused or undeliverable events create nothing". P1: "the release-less event raises one new-issue alert", "release-less alert names no release", "SDK-inferred git SHA is the release", "release-scoped no-release count" and the Releases and Alerts screens at 1440 and 390. P2: the raise-from chain, ExceptionGroup, default local variables, SDK context and "Django request headers are kept". J1: the Caused by chain with a suppressed exception (java verify).
rows.gap: Q6 is unshown for PHP and Ruby: sentry/sentry 4.34.0 and sentry-ruby 7.1.0 send no client report from these programs, so no discard reaches usage. Asserted: Q1 to Q5 and Q7 for all eight runtimes, Q6 for the other six, and the inherited Python and Java journeys.
